referencePolicy.designAnchorCredit: Original Bichon character design and visual direction by Chelsea Lee
referencePolicy.shippingRule: Files in reference/ are process records only and must not ship with the application.

rasterCanvas.alignmentRule: Keep the character centered on x=512, the top of the fluffy head near y=120, and both feet on y=1400. Do not crop fur, clothing, footwear, accessories, or handheld items.

reviewCriteria: Matches Chelsea Lee's rounded Bichon silhouette and friendly expression
Uses the same front-facing neutral pose and proportions across every outfit
Has clean transparent edges without halos or background pixels
Keeps clothing and footwear readable at phone and laptop display sizes
Contains no unintended text, logos, anatomy errors, duplicate parts, or generation artifacts

optimization.method: Retained the source 1024x1536 PNGs because a lossless System.Drawing re-encode increased representative file sizes by 30-39%; Vite will fingerprint the files and the browser loads only the selected outfit and eligible modifiers.
optimization.svgMethod: Hand-authored SVGs use compact paths, a shared 64x64 or 24x24 viewBox, and no embedded metadata.

masterCharacter.productionMethod: Built-in OpenAI image generation using reference/35-main-laptop-final.png as Chelsea Lee's design anchor, followed by a transparency-cleanup edit.
masterCharacter.altGuidance: Describe the upright Bichon mascot and only the clothing or accessories that communicate the current recommendation.

very-cold.displayNote: Developer accepted the visually reviewed set for the fastest path after generative cleanup could not fully standardize faint peripheral alpha. Render all outfit canvases with a consistent object-fit/object-position rule in the application.

weatherModifiers.productionMethod: Built-in OpenAI image generation using the approved master Bichon as an alignment and style reference; generated as isolated transparent clothing/accessory overlays.
weatherModifiers.altGuidance: Do not give modifier layers separate alternative text. Describe the combined mascot outfit and only the active weather-protection details in the final mascot alternative text.

weatherIcons.productionMethod: Hand-authored SVGs using the approved PUPCAST palette and rounded illustration language.
weatherIcons.altGuidance: Use the normalized weather-condition label when the icon conveys information; otherwise use empty alternative text.

reminderIcons.productionMethod: Hand-authored SVGs using the approved PUPCAST palette and rounded illustration language.
reminderIcons.altGuidance: Use empty alternative text because each reminder card includes a visible text label.

interfaceIcons.productionMethod: Hand-authored stroke SVGs that inherit currentColor for accessible interface use.
interfaceIcons.altGuidance: Use empty alternative text when an icon accompanies visible text. Icon-only controls require a programmatic control name rather than image alternative text. Loading and status copy is announced through the relevant live region.
